final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(film_actor_count) AS total_count FROM actor_counts), actor_shares AS (SELECT ac.actor_id, ac.film_actor_count, 1.0 * ac.film_actor_count / t.total_count AS actor_share FROM actor_counts ac JOIN totals t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(actor_share) AS average_share FROM actor_shares) SELECT s.actor_id, s.film_actor_count, s.actor_share, s.actor_share - a.average_share AS share_difference FROM actor_shares s JOIN averages a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_difference IS NULL, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
